# Support

## Asking a question or reporting a problem

Open an [issue](https://github.com/mralaminahamed/codetrail/issues/new/choose) using the bug report or
feature request form. GitHub Discussions are not enabled on this repository.

Before opening one, check the [README](../README.md), which covers setup, configuration, the API and
the known limits.

## Security problems

Do not open a public issue. Follow the [security policy](../SECURITY.md).

## Contributing

See the [contributing guide](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
